title: A real macOS screen recording, named as macOS names it (a narrow no-break space before PM), attaches to a new agent chat: the chat opens and stays drawn, its video tile or file chip shows, and app health never reloads or restarts the page
why: Leo, 2026-11-11: "i tried uploading this video to my nightly app and it just made the screen blank" (Screen Recording 2026-11-10 at 4.21.16 PM.mov, 2112x720 H.264, U+202F before PM). No journey attached a real screen recording before. That night the busy agent chat missed its beats, app health reloaded it and then killed its renderer 2 s later while the reload was still loading, twice, and the pane stayed blank; a reloaded page now gets PAGE_BOOT_MS (30 s) to boot, and a preview that throws falls back to the file chip (AttachmentPreviewBoundary). The fixture is a real screen recording made on the lease (screencapture -v), or an ffmpeg H.264 clip at 2112x720 where screen recording is not allowed; the name carries U+202F.

steps.text: D=$(mktemp -d) && F="$D/Screen Recording 2026-11-10 at 4.21.16$(printf '\342\200\257')PM.mov" && (screencapture -x -v -V 3 "$F" >/dev/null 2>&1 || ffmpeg -loglevel error -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=2112x720:rate=30 -t 9 -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p "$F") && test -s "$F" && echo fixture-${nonce}-ok

steps.title: the screen recording is on disk, named with U+202F

steps.text: cmux chat --name jr-attach-${nonce} --attach "$F" --json --prompt 'Reply with the single word ok.' | grep -q '"state":"accepted"' && echo attached-${nonce}-ok

steps.title: longer than a stuck page's 10 s, a reload's 30 s boot wait and a backoff: a page app health repairs would show by now
app health never repaired a page: no part is stuck, repairing or failed
